claims: The brief experiment summary records 28 labeled items, 12 accepted advisory labels, 12 correct accepted labels and 16 review outcomes; its two listed label errors were both review outcomes.

The grounded experiment records 28 labeled items, zero accepted advisory labels, 28 review outcomes and one listed label error. The active-field experiment also records 28 items, zero accepted labels, 28 review outcomes and one listed error.
The four supplied SDK usage records have code-computed totals of 51300 input tokens, 8169 output tokens and $0.0021546 cost; these totals exclude MCP and screening calls.
